From 6ef935e65902bfed53980ad2754b06a284ea8ac1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jian Shen <shenjian15@huawei.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 10:37:37 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] net: hns3: add VLAN id validation before using

Currently, the VLAN id may be used without validation when
receive a VLAN configuration mailbox from VF. The length of
vlan_del_fail_bmap is BITS_TO_LONGS(VLAN_N_VID). It may cause
out-of-bounds memory access once the VLAN id is bigger than
or equal to VLAN_N_VID.

Therefore, VLAN id needs to be checked to ensure it is within
the range of VLAN_N_VID.

Fixes: fe4144d47eef ("net: hns3: sync VLAN filter entries when kill VLAN ID failed")
Signed-off-by: Jian Shen <shenjian15@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: Jijie Shao <shaojijie@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Simon Horman <horms@kernel.org>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20251211023737.2327018-4-shaojijie@huawei.com
Signed-off-by: Paolo Abeni <pabeni@redhat.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/hisilicon/hns3/hns3pf/hclge_main.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/hisilicon/hns3/hns3pf/hclge_main.c
index cf8abbe01840..c589baea7c77 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/hisilicon/hns3/hns3pf/hclge_main.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/hisilicon/hns3/hns3pf/hclge_main.c
@@ -10555,6 +10555,9 @@ int hclge_set_vlan_filter(struct hnae3_handle *handle, __be16 proto,
 	bool writen_to_tbl = false;
 	int ret = 0;
 
+	if (vlan_id >= VLAN_N_VID)
+		return -EINVAL;
+
 	/* When device is resetting or reset failed, firmware is unable to
 	 * handle mailbox. Just record the vlan id, and remove it after
 	 * reset finished.
-- 
2.34.1

The patch adds a validated check for VLAN ID before use in the `hns3` driver to prevent an out-of-bounds memory access.

**Modifications in each file:**

- **`drivers/net/ethernet/hisilicon/hns3/hns3pf/hclge_main.c`**  
  In the `hclge_set_vlan_filter()` function, an early return statement is added: if `vlan_id >= VLAN_N_VID`, the function returns `-EINVAL` immediately.

**Relationship between modifications:**  
The single change ensures that any VLAN ID received from a VF via mailbox (or other sources) is verified to be within the valid range (0–4095) before being used. This prevents the VLAN ID from being used as an index into the `vlan_del_fail_bmap` array (which is sized to `BITS_TO_LONGS(VLAN_N_VID)` bits), thereby avoiding an out-of-bounds memory access that could be triggered by a malicious or buggy VF. The validation is placed at the very beginning of the function, before all other logic, so that invalid IDs are rejected early.
